name: Google Cloud GenAI credit
how_you_get_it: Granted by Google to some Cloud accounts. Not something you can sign up for.
trap: It is scoped to search products. It does not pay for Gemini, Veo or embeddings, which is what most people assume a Google AI credit is for.

balance.why_not_api: Same limitation as the trial credit: no API returns a promotional credit remainder. Checked 2026-08-21.

coverage.note: the grant is scoped to Agent Search and Vertex AI Search usage.
this credit is scoped to search products, not to model usage.
